hold_reason: Discrepancy between handoff and ledger: W2 reported refunds applied to orders 150 (12682 cents), 151 (15870 cents), and 155 (4209 cents), but list_refunds returns an empty list. Net balances computed from the ledger would overstate payouts for acme, birch, and cobalt. Holding until the refunds are confirmed in the shared ledger.
